budgetHeadroom.costCaveat: This is an internal estimated-cost admission threshold, not a provider invoice or a strict maximum of 5 USD incurred: the final admitted response brought the estimate to 5.0523144. Unknown actual pricing prevents a billed-cost claim.

verificationCaveats: This is a real failing-tests-to-passing-tests iteration, but not strict unchanged-test red-before-original-fix proof: source edits preceded new regression execution and one test assertion was corrected.

The built-in test_runner executes the source runtime module, while separate pytest commands import the changed target checkout. Its second 10-passed fixture result must not be treated as verification of the modified target code.
The final 3/36 passing counts are direct pytest results from the target cwd, not inferred from the broken built-in parser, which reported misleading counts on earlier runs.
The target change includes behavior beyond removing the ten-file cap; passing these tests alone does not establish absence of other regressions.
task.outcome verificationStatus remains failed because its aggregate keeps earlier failed observations (4 passed, 3 failed); this does not negate the later concrete 36-pass test output.
The three reviewer-discovered regressions were supplied as explicit host feedback, and neither review turn reached a repair or validation.
No login/authentication failure can be attributed to CodeLoop: it never attempted gh authentication or PR creation; parent checks login separately.

The final retries are transport failures after read-only work and planning. They do not demonstrate that the runtime cannot edit, but do show the requested delivery was not completed in this bounded experiment.
